group.description: Optional com.professorbutts.sports.list of accounts (a friends group) to be ranked within.

tiebreaker.description: Guess of the combined final score of the contest's tiebreaker slot.

main.description: Recommended key: the contest's rkey, so a fan has one bracket per contest. Any key is accepted; if several exist, the newest counts.

team.description: com.professorbutts.sports.team record picked to win the slot.

description: One player's whole bracket for a bracket-format com.professorbutts.sports.contest, kept in the player's own repo: a predicted winner for every slot, later rounds included. Updated in place; a slot's pick only counts if an indexer saw it before that slot locked.
